import re
from datetime import datetime
now=datetime.now(); this_year=now.year
creds=apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
fs_pass=[c['password'] for c in creds if c['account_name']=='file_system'][0]
fs_token=apis.file_system.login(username='chrharrison@gmail.com', password=fs_pass)['access_token']

cable_dir='~/bills/cable/'
files=apis.file_system.show_directory(directory_path=cable_dir, access_token=fs_token)
year_files=sorted([f for f in files if str(this_year) in f])
print('year_files', year_files)

totals=[]
for path in year_files:
    data=apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=path, access_token=fs_token)
    content=data['content']
    m=re.search(r'Total Amount\s*=>\s*\$?\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)', content)
    if not m:
        print('no total in', path)
        print(content)
        continue
    total=float(m.group(1))
    totals.append((path,total))
    print('file', path, 'total', total)

sum_total=sum(t for _,t in totals)
print('sum_total', sum_total)

# if all totals are integers, cast
if all(abs(t-round(t))<1e-9 for _,t in totals):
    sum_total_int=int(round(sum_total))
    print('sum_total_int', sum_total_int)
